title: Hot air balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- balloon envelope -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='35' rx='28' ry='32' fill='#ff4d4d'/>
  <!-- stripe panels -->
  <path d='M50 3 C38 3 30 18 30 35 C30 52 38 67 50 67 Z' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <path d='M50 3 C62 3 70 18 70 35 C70 52 62 67 50 67 Z' fill='#ff8833'/>
  <path d='M50 3 C44 3 40 18 40 35 C40 52 44 67 50 67 Z' fill='#ffdd66'/>
  <path d='M50 3 C56 3 60 18 60 35 C60 52 56 67 50 67 Z' fill='#ffaa44'/>
  <!-- highlight on balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='22' rx='10' ry='14' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.25'/>
  <!-- balloon bottom opening -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='12' ry='4' fill='#cc3333'/>
  <!-- balloon bottom rim highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='12' ry='4' fill='none' stroke='#ff8866' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <!-- ropes -->
  <line x1='38' y1='67' x2='42' y2='80' stroke='#dddddd' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='67' x2='58' y2='80' stroke='#dddddd' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='67' x2='44' y2='80' stroke='#dddddd' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='67' x2='56' y2='80' stroke='#dddddd' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- basket -->
  <rect x='38' y='80' width='24' height='14' rx='2' fill='#c8862a'/>
  <!-- basket weave lines -->
  <line x1='38' y1='84' x2='62' y2='84' stroke='#a8681a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='88' x2='62' y2='88' stroke='#a8681a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='80' x2='44' y2='94' stroke='#a8681a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='80' x2='50' y2='94' stroke='#a8681a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='80' x2='56' y2='94' stroke='#a8681a' stroke-width='1'/>
  <!-- basket rim -->
  <rect x='36' y='78' width='28' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e0a040'/>
  <!-- small flame -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='3' ry='5' fill='#ffaa00'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='71' rx='1.5' ry='3' fill='#ffee66'/>
</svg>
